cite.original: To dream of seeing trout, is significant of growing prosperity.
cite.translation_ko: 송어를 보는 꿈은, 운수가 점점 트일 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that you will be happily conditioned

cite.original: To eat some, denotes that you will be happily conditioned.
cite.translation_ko: 송어를 먹는 꿈은, 만족스러운 처지에 놓일 조짐이다

cite.original: To catch one with a hook, foretells assured pleasure and competence.
cite.translation_ko: 낚싯바늘로 송어를 낚는 꿈은, 확실한 즐거움과 능력을 예고한다

interpretation_en: you will have a short season of happiness

cite.original: If it falls back into the water, you will have a short season of happiness.
cite.translation_ko: 낚은 송어가 다시 물속으로 떨어지는 꿈은, 행복이 짧게 이어질 조짐이다

interpretation_en: is a sign of unparalleled prosperity

cite.original: To catch them with a seine, is a sign of unparalleled prosperity.
cite.translation_ko: 그물로 송어를 잡는 꿈은, 견줄 데 없는 번영의 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 사랑에서의 성공이 도리어 슬픔과 낙담을 불러올 조짐
interpretation_en: shows that your success in love will bring you to grief and disappointments

cite.original: To see them in muddy water shows that your success in love will bring you to grief and disappointments.
cite.translation_ko: 흐린 물속의 송어를 보는 꿈은, 사랑에서의 성공이 도리어 슬픔과 낙담을 불러올 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 사업이 어려워졌다 되살아나며 가난을 이겨낼 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes you will experience reaction in unfavorable business, and will vanquish poverty

cite.original: To dream of a trowel, denotes you will experience reaction in unfavorable business, and will vanquish poverty.
cite.translation_ko: 흙손 꿈을 꾸면, 사업이 어려워졌다 되살아나며 가난을 이겨낼 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 피할 수 없는 불운이 빠르게 다가올 조짐
interpretation_en: unavoidable ill luck is fast approaching you

cite.original: To see one rusty or broken, unavoidable ill luck is fast approaching you.
cite.translation_ko: 녹슬거나 부서진 흙손을 보는 꿈은, 피할 수 없는 불운이 빠르게 다가올 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 예사롭지 않은 흥미로운 일이 곧 닥칠 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that something of unusual interest is about to befall you

cite.original: To dream of a trumpet, denotes that something of unusual interest is about to befall you.
cite.translation_ko: 나팔 꿈을 꾸면, 예사롭지 않은 흥미로운 일이 곧 닥칠 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that you will soon go on a pleasant trip

cite.original: To pack your trunk, denotes that you will soon go on a pleasant trip.
cite.translation_ko: 짐가방을 꾸리는 꿈은, 머잖아 즐거운 여행을 떠날 조짐이다

context: 짐가방 속 물건이 어지러이 흩어져 있음
interpretation_ko: 다툼이 있고 서둘러 떠난 여행에서 불만족만 남을 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells quarrels, and a hasty journey from which only dissatisfaction will accrue

cite.original: To see the contents of a trunk thrown about in disorder, foretells quarrels, and a hasty journey from which only dissatisfaction will accrue.
cite.translation_ko: 짐가방 속 물건이 어지러이 흩어져 있는 꿈은, 다툼이 있고 서둘러 떠난 여행에서 불만족만 남을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: foretell disappointment in love and marriage

cite.original: Empty trunks foretell disappointment in love and marriage.
cite.translation_ko: 빈 트렁크를 보는 꿈은, 사랑과 혼인에서 낙담할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: is an omen of advancement and comfort

cite.original: For a drummer to check his trunk, is an omen of advancement and comfort.
cite.translation_ko: 행상인이 제 짐가방을 확인하는 꿈은, 출세와 편안함의 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 머잖아 승진 소식을 듣고 바라던 바를 이룰 조짐
interpretation_en: he will soon hear of his promotion, and his desires will reach gratification

cite.original: If he finds that his trunk is too small for his wares, he will soon hear of his promotion, and his desires will reach gratification.
cite.translation_ko: 짐가방이 상품에 비해 작음을 보는 꿈은, 머잖아 승진 소식을 듣고 바라던 바를 이룰 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 부유한 사람을 얻으려 애쓰나 뜻밖의 일로 그 기회를 잃을 조짐
interpretation_en: signifies that she will make an effort to win some wealthy person, but by a misadventure she will lose her chance

cite.original: For a young woman to dream that she tries to unlock her trunk and can't, signifies that she will make an effort to win some wealthy person, but by a misadventure she will lose her chance.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 짐가방을 열려다 못 여는 꿈은, 부유한 사람을 얻으려 애쓰나 뜻밖의 일로 그 기회를 잃을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: she will be disappointed in making a desired trip

cite.original: If she fails to lock her trunk, she will be disappointed in making a desired trip.
cite.translation_ko: 짐가방을 못 잠그는 꿈은, 바라던 여행에서 낙담할 조짐이다
